scope: Current Sayaka feature-subset capability ledger for C0 guarded-host planning. Not parity and not competitive-result evidence. Supersedes v2 for planning; v2 remains the immutable record of its time.

capabilities.details: Terminal browser and scan exploration implemented; no claim of full Mole overview/TUI parity.
Rule-bound trash and validation slices implemented; broad maintenance/clean catalogs remain out of scope.

Single-bundle uninstall execution (revalidated_bundle_trash_v1) and read-only coexisting-copy evidence implemented; multi-copy execution, related-data selection, shared/restart-required evidence and official uninstaller flows remain gaps.
Read-only installer discovery/preview plus explicitly approved ordinary-file cleanup implemented; no full installer cleanup parity claim.

Marker-bound artifact preview and bounded per-item Trash execution (revalidated_purge_trash_v1) implemented; the execution contract's disposable-fixture native evidence is pending, and custom root sets / staleness-filtering UX remain gaps.

Read-only bounded CLI diagnostics for disk_verify, login_items_audit and the mdutil system_maintenance observation (3 of 21 pinned catalog tasks); effect classes B/C require per-operation contracts, Class D stays blocked on the privilege design, and isolated-host native acceptance is pending.
Read-only status sampler exists with known metric coverage gaps versus Mole; numeric temperature is a recorded deliberate gap.
Owned-prefix install/update/recover/remove plus completion implemented for local profile; not full distribution parity.
